Class OidcRedirects

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.who.oidc.OidcRedirects
public final class OidcRedirects extends Object
Where a provider sign-in sends the browser: the success URL, or the failure URL with an error code added to its query.

  • Constructor Details

    • OidcRedirects

      public OidcRedirects(String successUrl, String failureUrl)
      Creates the redirects, with links landing on the success URL.
      Parameters:
      successUrl - where a sign-in lands; a local path
      failureUrl - where a pending sign-up and every failed sign-in land; a local path
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when either is not a local path

    • OidcRedirects

      public OidcRedirects(String successUrl, String failureUrl, String linkUrl)
      Creates the redirects.
      Parameters:
      successUrl - where a sign-in lands; a local path
      failureUrl - where a pending sign-up and every failed sign-in land; a local path
      linkUrl - where a link the signed-in person asked for lands; a local path
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when any is not a local path
